# Exact constant-delay boundary; finite Lambert branches are witnesses, not a proof
print('a=1 k=2: omega_c=',wc,'exact tau_c=',tc,'Padé boundary=',2/(k-a))
rows=[];fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,3.7))
for tau in [0.,.5,1.,tc,1.5,2.]:
    roots=np.array([-a-k],complex) if tau==0 else -a+lambertw(-k*tau*np.exp(a*tau),np.arange(-20,21))/tau
    residual=0. if tau==0 else max(abs(roots+a+k*np.exp(-roots*tau))/(1+abs(roots)))
    alpha=float(max(roots.real));rows.append({'tau':float(tau),'scannedRootMaxReal':alpha,'relativeCharacteristicResidual':float(residual)})
    print(rows[-1]);assert residual<1e-10
    if tau in [.5,1.5]:ax.scatter(roots.real,roots.imag,s=15,label='tau='+str(tau))
ax.axvline(0,color='black',ls='--');ax.set(xlabel='Re(s)',ylabel='Im(s)',xlim=(-5,1),ylim=(-10,10));ax.legend();ax.grid();plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('tau1.5 has an actual RHP characteristic root, despite stable first-order Padé poles')
print('exact_margin_complete')

# Uniform sufficient certificate for all CONSTANT delays in [0,bar_tau]
print('small-gain strict delay threshold=',tsg)
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,3.7))
for bar_tau in [.5,1.,1.5]:
    omega=np.r_[0,np.logspace(-3,3,1001),2/bar_tau]
    T=k/np.sqrt(omega**2+(a+k)**2)
    bound=T*np.minimum(omega*bar_tau,2)
    actual=T*2*abs(np.sin(omega*bar_tau/2))
    B=2*k*bar_tau/np.hypot(2,(a+k)*bar_tau)
    print('bar_tau=',bar_tau,'analytic sup envelope=',B,'certificate=',B<1,'sample max=',max(bound))
    assert max(abs(actual)-bound)<1e-12 and abs(max(bound)-B)<1e-12
    if bar_tau==.5:ax.plot(omega[:1002],actual[:1002],label='actual error product');ax.plot(omega[:1002],bound[:1002],label='envelope product')
print('k=a=1 bar_tau=2: bound=',4/np.sqrt(20),'strict for every finite bar_tau')
ax.set(xlabel='rad/s',ylabel='nominal T times delay error',xlim=(0,8),ylim=(0,2));ax.legend();ax.grid();plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('small_gain_complete')

# Independent method of steps with dense DOP853 history, not a Padé replacement
times=np.linspace(0,12,601);responses=[]
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(13,3.6))
for ax,tau in zip(axes,[.5,1.,1.5]):
    x=dde(a,k,tau,times);xp=pade_trace(a,k,tau,times)
    pp=np.roots([tau/2,1+(a-k)*tau/2,a+k])
    responses.append({'tau':tau,'x12':float(x[-1]),'pade12':float(xp[-1]),'padeMaxReal':float(max(pp.real))})
    print(responses[-1]);ax.plot(times,x,label='DDE');ax.plot(times,xp,'--',label='Pade');ax.set(title='tau='+str(tau),xlabel='time (s)',ylabel='state');ax.legend();ax.grid()
plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('phi(t)=1 on [-tau,0]; no disturbance; Pade memory state initially 1')
print('history_response_complete')

# Delay-independent sufficient Halanay estimate, including bounded time-varying delay
a_h,k_h,tau_h=1.,.5,1.
eta=brentq(lambda z:a_h-k_h*np.exp(z*tau_h)-z,0,a_h-k_h)
times=np.linspace(0,12,601);x=dde(a_h,k_h,tau_h,times);envelope=np.exp(-eta*times)
print('a=1 k=.5 bar_tau=1: eta=',eta,'max sampled envelope violation=',max(abs(x)-envelope))
assert max(abs(x)-envelope)<1e-8
print('default a1 k2 does not satisfy a>k; theorem silent, not a proof of instability')
print('zero delay default x(t)=exp(-3t); same x0 with different histories need not have same first derivative')
print('phi=1: derivative at 0 = -3; phi(t)=1+sin(pi*t/tau): derivative also -3 but later history differs')
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,3.7));ax.plot(times,abs(x),label='constant-delay DDE |x|');ax.plot(times,envelope,'--',label='Halanay bound for all admissible bounded delays');ax.set(xlabel='time (s)',ylabel='magnitude');ax.legend();ax.grid();plt.tight_layout();plt.show()
print('halanay_complete')

# Four exercises, all numerical subparts independently reproducible
print('Q1 characteristic s+1+2 exp(-s tau)=0; tau_c=',tc,'omega_c=',wc)
print('Q1 phi=1 and tau>0: derivative0=-3; tau0: x12=',np.exp(-36))
print('Q2 strict SG threshold=',tsg,'tau1 bound=',4/np.sqrt(13),'actual tau1 is below exact tau_c')
print('Q3 tau1.5 Pade roots=',np.roots([.75,.25,3]))
root=-1+lambertw(-3*np.exp(1.5))/1.5
print('Q3 one exact DDE RHP root=',root,'residual=',abs(root+1+2*np.exp(-root*1.5)))
eta=brentq(lambda z:1-.5*np.exp(z)-z,0,.5)
print('Q4 Halanay eta=',eta,'bound at t2=',np.exp(-2*eta))
print('Q4 a=k finite constant delays stable; no positive eta from this Halanay condition')
print('all_answers_complete')
